login.title: Sign in to SureCure Visit
login.lead: Use the email or mobile number you signed up with.
login.methodLabel: How do you want to sign in?

signup.title: Create your SureCure Visit account
signup.lead: Choose how you will use SureCure Visit. Providers are checked by our team before patients can book them.
signup.roleHint: Staff and admin accounts are created by invitation only.
signup.methodLabel: How do you want to sign up?
signup.checkEmailBody: If {email} can be used for a new account, we have sent a confirmation link to it. Open the link, then sign in.
signup.privacyBody: We use your email or mobile number only to sign you in and to contact you about your requests. Health details are asked later, during onboarding, and you can answer Unknown.
signup.termsLabel: I agree to the terms of use and have read the privacy notice
signup.termsHint: Both documents are drafts until the company publishes approved versions.

fields.phoneHint: We will send a 6-digit code to this number.
fields.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code. You can paste it.

otp.title: Enter the code we sent
otp.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {seconds} seconds.
otp.resendExhausted: No more codes can be sent for this attempt. Start again in a few minutes.
otp.attemptsLeft: {count, plural, one {1 attempt left} other {# attempts left}}

errors.invalidCredentials: That email or password is incorrect.
errors.accountRestricted: This account is restricted. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
errors.accountExists: An account already exists with these details. Sign in instead.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.rateLimitedSeconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.methodUnavailable: Signing in with a mobile number is not available yet. Use your email address.
errors.otpInvalid: That code is incorrect. Check the message and try again.
errors.otpExpired: That code has expired. Ask for a new code.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.

fieldErrors.email_invalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
fieldErrors.terms_required: You need to agree before creating an account.
fieldErrors.otp_format: Enter the 6 digits of the code.

notices.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue where you left off.

recover.title: Reset your password
recover.unavailableTitle: Password reset is not available yet
recover.unavailableBody: We cannot reset passwords from this site yet. Contact SureCure Visit support from the contact page and we will help you get back in.

denied.title: You do not have access to this page
denied.forbidden: This page belongs to a different account or workspace. If you think you should see it, contact support.
denied.account_restricted: Your account is restricted, so private pages are not available. Contact support for help.
denied.unavailable: We could not check your access just now. Try again in a moment.

pending.title: Your request has been sent to the admin
pending.lead: Thank you for applying. Our admin team will check your details and documents. Until they approve your request, your dashboard stays closed and this is the only page you will see.

sent.title: Request sent
sent.body: Your details and documents are with the SureCure Visit admin team.

review.title: Admin verifies and accepts
review.body: We check your registration and documents. If something is missing, we will ask you to update your application.

open.title: Your {role} dashboard opens
open.body: Only after the admin accepts your request can you sign in and reach your dashboard.

pending.signInAgain: You do not need to do anything else. Sign in again later to see if your request has been accepted.

workspace.title: Choose a workspace
workspace.lead: Your account has more than one workspace. Pick where you want to go.
workspace.empty: No workspaces are available for this account yet.
workspace.emptyBody: If you signed up as a provider, finish your application first.

account.signOutBody: Signing out removes your session from this browser.
account.otherSessionsBody: Ending sessions on other devices is not available yet.
account.mfaBody: Two-step verification is required for staff and admin accounts and is set up by invitation. Self-service setup is not available yet.
account.privacyLead: Your health details are private. Only you and people you allow can see them.
account.consentBody: A history of the consents you gave is not available to view here yet.
account.exportTitle: Get a copy of your data
account.exportBody: Data copies and deletion follow the company's approved retention rules, which are not published yet. To ask, contact support. We do not delete records instantly from this page.
